# Github code embed

To embed code from a github page you can use the site [https://emgithub.com/](https://emgithub.com/).

To do so:

1. Put the link to the github file into the top bar
2. Change the theme from `Default` to `A 11 Y Dark` or `A 11 Y Light`
    - The default does not work properly with the dark theme of our websites
3. Press `Go`
4. Copy the code form the `<script>` to embed
5. Paste the code into your .qmd file

For example:

Github link: [https://github.com/m-gemmell/Quarto_guide/blob/main/qmds/example_github_code.R](https://github.com/m-gemmell/Quarto_guide/blob/main/qmds/example_github_code.R)

The script for embedding (A 11 Y Dark):


::: {.cell}

```{.bash .cell-code}
<script src="https://emgithub.com/embed-v2.js?target=https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2Fm-gemmell%2FQuarto_guide%2Fblob%2Fmain%2Fqmds%2Fexample_github_code.R&style=a11y-dark&type=code&showBorder=on&showLineNumbers=on&showFileMeta=on&showFullPath=on&showCopy=on"></script>
```
:::


The embed:

<script src="https://emgithub.com/embed-v2.js?target=https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2Fm-gemmell%2FQuarto_guide%2Fblob%2Fmain%2Fqmds%2Fexample_github_code.R&style=a11y-dark&type=code&showBorder=on&showLineNumbers=on&showFileMeta=on&showFullPath=on&showCopy=on"></script>

The same embed but with A 11 Light looks like so:

<script src="https://emgithub.com/embed-v2.js?target=https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2Fm-gemmell%2FQuarto_guide%2Fblob%2Fmain%2Fqmds%2Fexample_github_code.R&style=a11y-light&type=code&showBorder=on&showLineNumbers=on&showFileMeta=on&showFullPath=on&showCopy=on"></script>
